name: Haemonetics Corporation
summary: Haemonetics Corporation, a medical technology company, provides a suite of hospital technologies solutions. The company operates through Plasma, Blood Center, and Hospital segments. It provides automated plasma collection systems, donor management software, and supporting software solutions, such as NexSys PCS plasmapheresis equipment system and related disposables and solutions, as well as integrated information technology platforms for plasma customers to manage their donors, operations, and supply chain; and NexLynk DMS donor management system and Donor360 tools. The company also offers treatment in electrophysiology, critical care, neurocritical care, trauma, burn surgery, spine surgery,…
